title: Skill memory scope for ledgers
summary: Per-run execution traces are telemetry, not canonical alignment memory
remedy: Persist only durable ambiguities, hallucinations, and dead-end patterns; keep run traces out of the canonical memory surface

title: Framework naming pivot
summary: The repository is pivoting from DEOS as the framework name to DEOS (Deterministic Economic Operating System). DEOS is now correctly positioned as the economic standard running on top of DEOS.
remedy: Use DEOS when referring to the runtime, scheduler, and infrastructure. Use DEOS when referring to the specific economic specification (the standard) running on it.

title: Low-signal ledger entries
summary: Gate-only pass/fail labels are not durable memory unless they capture the repeated drift pattern, affected surface, and expected correction path
remedy: Reject low-signal gate-only titles and require scoped remedy-bearing records

title: Prelaunch contraction delta conflict
summary: The original exact-zero count notation conflicted with the mandatory removal of pre-genesis compatibility shadows.
remedy: Interpret closure counts as no-growth constraints and require count deltas at or below zero; removal of unsupported dispatch, storage, and runtime API surfaces remains admissible.

title: Reference upgrade authorization had no executable proposal ingress
summary: The urgent runtime-upgrade path could authorize an existing L1RootAction proposal through unanimous VETO Pass, but proposal creation remained AdminOnly under EnsureRoot with no declared live Root ingress.
remedy: Use PrimaryEligibleSigned on the existing proposal call for protocol L1RootAction only; derive eligibility from nonzero primary-track staking power, retain fee/cap/rollback semantics, and leave Root-equivalent execution inside the bounded payload executor. VETO remains protection-only.

title: Exact baseline cannot use candidate governance ingress
summary: The apparent causality blocker came from treating pre-1.0 source tags as deployed runtime lineage, although no downstream product network may launch before DEOS 1.0.
remedy: Treat every 0.x line as fresh-genesis source with breaking changes and no migrations; keep runtime version 1 and require live upgrade evidence only after a downstream production genesis at 1.0 or later.

title: Parachain validation fixed-overhead owner
summary: Upstream cumulus set_validation_data declares zero dispatch Weight and explicitly leaves its non-message overhead unbenchmarked, while only selected hook/message work is registered dynamically; additionally, the SDK DMP reserve is not directly consumed by the reference runtime's EnqueueWithOrigin adapter, so DEOS replaced its fictitious 25% value with the measured finite owner and derived a 512-message cap from the relay 32 MiB allocation and sanitized 64 KiB minimum but must still enforce it in Prepass check_inherents, so DEOS cannot yet claim a conservative FixedBlockWeight from FRAME counters or nominal reserve constants alone.
remedy: Introduce measured bounded DEOS ownership for validation-context overhead, classify each active DMP/XCMP path, enforce the declared 512-message DMP cap plus finite XCMP full/hashed bounds pre-execution through the Prepass check_inherents owner, remove or replace unbound legacy reserves, then combine the resulting maxima component-wise with Timestamp and all other fixed hooks before activating the resource budget.

title: Message Queue hook phase misclassification
summary: Pallet order initially suggested Message Queue consumed its 35% service envelope during on_idle before Actors, but runtime configuration binds that envelope to ServiceWeight while IdleMaxServiceWeight is disabled; Message Queue therefore runs in on_initialize, and XCMP Queue on_idle owns only bounded lazy migration.
remedy: Classify Message Queue on_initialize and the bounded XCMP lazy-migration reserve under FixedBlockWeight; retain the simple ExternalPhase to FreshDrain transition and do not invent an ExternalIdleService resource domain.

title: Session rotation consumes the full block Weight
summary: Upstream pallet_session::on_initialize returns RuntimeBlockWeights::max_block whenever the six-hour PeriodicSessions boundary rotates, so a static FixedBlockWeight that honestly covers every block leaves zero schedulable Actor/User capacity.
remedy: Move periodic rotation into a small benchmarked DEOS pallet that calls public pallet_session::rotate_session, bind upstream ShouldEndSession to a never-ending adapter while retaining periodic NextSessionRotation, and use the generated bounded hook owner; retaining the full charge is rejected because it leaves zero Actor Control for the required Prepass.

title: Session rotation consumes the full block Weight
summary: Resolved by moving periodic rotation to pallet-deos-session-rotation, disabling upstream ShouldEndSession rotation, retaining PeriodicSessions prediction, and binding a 120-identity runtime benchmark owner.
remedy: Retain generated session rotation Weight in FixedBlockWeight and regenerate whenever session geometry or manager composition changes.

title: Maximum context benchmark needs a no-std relay-proof fixture
summary: Benchmarking the complete set_validation_data path cannot call its private enqueue leaves or construct BasicParachainInherentData from defaults; the measured callback must retain a valid relay proof and maximum abridged message data prepared outside the measured block.
remedy: Use an associated benchmark fixture type on the Actors BenchmarkHelper and gate no-std cumulus-test-relay-sproof-builder under runtime-benchmarks; prepare the valid BasicParachainInherentData plus InboundMessagesData outside #[block], dispatch set_validation_data inside it, and verify registered-versus-unregistered component ownership before binding Weight.

title: Maximum context benchmark needs a no-std relay-proof fixture
summary: Resolved with a validated static SCALE BasicParachainInherentData proof keyed to benchmark ParaId 100, exact included_para_head, and maximum DMP/HRMP MQC heads; setup reconstructs abridged messages outside measurement and the Wasm benchmark executes set_validation_data successfully.
remedy: Retain fixture hash 720062c34020ad38b5c56e7772befd24a38775a7b3dff547c4b5b28dac97ae17 and regenerate whenever context bounds, ParaId benchmark genesis, MQC construction, proof topology, or message allocation changes.
